newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish PM says EMU requires constitution change.
newsitem.headline: Swedish PM says EMU requires constitution change.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Wednesday he believed the country would need to change its constitution if it was to become a member of the currency union of the EMU.
"I believe that a change would be needed in the constitution," Persson told reporters after a parliamentary debate.
"To avoid ending up in a situation in which we discuss whether a change is needed or not in the constitution, we want to discuss the matter with the other party leaders right now."
Finance Minister Erik Asbrink has said in the past a change in the constitution would be needed to end the Riksbank's (central bank's) monopoly on issuing banknotes.
